tasks.title: Discover projects and registered live recordings
tasks.outcome: Read docs/plans/workflow-monitor-multiproject-tinyspec.md, especially Goal 1, as requirements truth. Deliver a read-only project/live-recording inventory in workflow_monitor/projects.py with opaque stable project/recording refs and concise main/linked source labels. Validate an expanded configurable root; inspect immediate-child Git worktree roots only, group canonical common/admin identities, derive registered main rather than guessing from branch/cwd/name, and deduplicate canonical aliases. Parse Git's registered worktree inventory safely, including external Paseo-style and spaced paths, without scanning Paseo or following arbitrary root-child symlink escapes. Retain one live Reader per binding: unavailable sources cannot hide healthy sources, no-store is empty and later reveals its first legitimate store, replaced storage is never silently rebound. Project inventory must not snapshot every database. Supply main-destination resolution for T003 and recording resolution for T004; exclude HTTP/UI and preservation writes. Document actual discovery behavior in workflow_monitor/README.md. REQUIRED G1: prove grouping, isolation, honest empty/error states and no writes with real tiny Git fixtures and actual Reader. Keep current safe ownership/admin/DB/metric protections. All tasks preserve graph/layout, nodes/edges, Details, labels, execution versus acceptance, metrics/coverage, explicit followups, pagination, filter/order, freshness and 60-second polling; add only project selection/source context outside the renderer. Web is numeric-loopback read-only with fixed assets, Host/same-origin protections and closed DTOs/errors; browser refs are never filesystem paths. Separate preserved recordings under main are owner-selected, not native live-DB imports. No runtime guards, SCC/version propagation, incremental sync, automatic preservation/discovery-refresh obligation, worktree navigation level, legacy rejection machinery, recursive/hardcoded scanning, generalized archive framework, cleanup, dependency upgrades or provider/setup/install/deploy calls. ADR-0003 (docs/decisions/ADR-0003-current-launch-authority-and-neutral-tasks.md): consume current runner authority, not historical phase restrictions. ADR-0004 (docs/decisions/ADR-0004-shared-routine-worker-permissions.md): small isolated Git/SQLite/JSONL/server/browser fixtures and removal of only explicitly created fixture worktrees are allowed without routine reapproval; no actual owner-data preservation/removal, paid/live workflows, push or unrelated service/data actions. Use prepared tools, report unavailable checks as NOT RUN and failed checks honestly; failed seam evidence blocks affected reliance, not unrelated work. Work only in owned_paths; preserve unrelated changes. Workers do not stage/commit or delegate; runner owns focused verified task checkpoints and independent final review. REQUIRED command from repository root: PYTHONPATH=runtime:runtime/tests workflow_monitor/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest -v workflow_monitor.tests.test_projects workflow_monitor.tests.test_reader. Return actual results and distinguishing inventory/state/no-write assertions as evidence.

required.pass_condition: Two immediate-child repositories and a real registered external linked worktree with a spaced path group correctly, equal run IDs stay recording-local, aliases deduplicate, nested repositories/arbitrary symlink escapes are excluded. required.permission: ADR-0004 isolated fixtures only; no real preservation/deletion or setup/provider calls; no manual gate for routine tests. Missing/failed evidence blocks reliance on this inventory.

Capture a consistent committed SQLite snapshot including WAL plus associated metric bytes, detecting source identity/content change across capture. Deliver only self-contained monitor run descriptors, ordered observations including unknown/incomplete qualification, review executions/attempts/input checkpoints, and typed dispatch/metric-artifact history fields consumed by Reader. Never raw-copy runtime DB or mixed-purpose history/private prompts, execution_run_inputs, runnable progress, unrelated legacy tables or SDK sessions. Preserve associated JSONL bytes including partial tails; absent stays absent, existing unreadable/unsafe artifact fails actionably instead of silent loss. Publish new separate recording under main .coherence with small private preparation and complete-only no-overwrite boundary. Reopen via T002 production Reader and compare retained monitor facts and metric availability before success. Stable origin identity makes exact repeat verify/reuse without duplicate; interrupted/uncertain publication retry cannot overwrite or duplicate a complete capture. A changed stopped source after capture is a mismatch, not sync/versioning: retain both and explicitly tell owner source differs and must be retained while resolving the difference. Do not require successful terminal run or available process telemetry. Success reports preserved workflow identities, metric qualifications and verified readback; errors name affected operation and corrective action, never claim deletion safe. Public preserved IDs use <workflow-name or hash>-<old id> with stable hash disambiguation; internal IDs unchanged. Document actual command, storage, stopped/repeat/mismatch/error limits, historical commitments, and no automatic deletion/resume in workflow_monitor/README.md and necessary storage guidance only in docs/coordinate-implementation-schema.md. REQUIRED G2/G3 uses permanent actual helper/CLI real Git+SQLite WAL+JSONL tests; prove private complete safe round trip before consumers rely on capture, not a disposable prototype chain or exhaustive fault framework. Preserve source/main native DB rows/files/metrics/private data/Git index and all prior captures; only new command-owned capture files and ordinary lock coordination may change. No native live-DB imports, runtime guard/SCC/version propagation, incremental sync, generalized importer, source pruning/deletion, Git merges, web write routes or automatic setup/install/provider/deploy. Keep workflow presentation/semantics and polling unchanged. ADR-0003 docs/decisions/ADR-0003-current-launch-authority-and-neutral-tasks.md: current launch authority, neutral tasks. ADR-0004 docs/decisions/ADR-0004-shared-routine-worker-permissions.md: bounded isolated Git/DB/servers/fixture source removal allowed without routine reapproval; no actual owner-data preserve/removal, paid/live workflows, unrelated services, push/deploy. Prepared tools only; missing checks are NOT RUN and failed safety proof blocks affected reliance, never weakens acceptance. Workers own listed paths only, preserve unrelated changes and do not stage/commit/delegate; runner owns verified checkpoints.
